sentences.text: The writ petitions are filed for following relief:

2.The writ petitioners are aggrieved by the fact that the representations dated 03.12.2009, followed by a reminder on 18.12.2023, seeking reference under Section 20 of Tamil Nadu National Highways Act [hereinafter in short Act'] to the Civil Court for enhancement of compensation fixed in award No.12 of 2009 dated 30.09.2009 has not been referred to the Civil Court.
2. Considering the limited relief sought for and taking note of the fact that the application for referring the matter under Section 20 of the Act had been filed within a period of less than 30 days,
is issued to the 1st respondent to consider the representations and refer the matter to the Civil Court under Section 20 of the Act within a period of three weeks.
